aiGuidance.purpose: verified, secondary, observed, not-read, recalled, unevidenced or none-required. Record the level actually reached, never the level you wish you had reached — understating costs nothing and overstating is the failure this register exists to catch. Constitutive claims and scope denials take none-required. A claim may not be affirmed until this is set.
